commit.message:
fix(dashboard): datastore names truncate instead of pushing the status off mobile (w4/244)

On Key Value and Postgres detail pages the name/status row kept its
content width, so the title's truncate never engaged: an accepted
30-character name pushed the status badge past a 390px viewport and the
page scrolled sideways.

Before (390px): Key Value document 390/416 with Available ending at
x416; Postgres 390/412.
After: the ready row and its pending skeleton row are bounded to the
header; the name ellipsizes (full heading text kept), the badge ends at
x374, and the document is 390/390. Desktop, short names and the Postgres
action menu position are unchanged.
